caveats: Every count is a floor. ENA holds runs with an empty tax_id that no taxonomy query reaches, so true per-species totals are higher (issue #2).
A run count is not a strain count. 52 of the 113 largest species take half or more of their isolates from a single study.
est_depth_x is base_count over a reference assembly size: metadata, not a measurement on the reads.
Only the 113 species with 100 or more isolates were reconciled against NCBI. Elsewhere ncbi_status is not_checked, which is not the same as absent.

default_panel.selection_rule: one run per isolate, deepest wins; then round-robin across studies. A sampling rule, not a guarantee of independence.
